title: Add formatEta
prompt: Add `formatEta(minutes)` to `src/util/duration.ts`. It returns `45 min` for anything under an hour, `2 h 05 min` for an hour or more (minutes padded to two digits), and `2 h` when the minutes are exactly zero. Non-finite or negative input throws a RangeError. Add tests for it to the existing test file for that module.
